newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 11 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 11 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday raised 11 million dinars at its weekly auction of Treasury bills dated May 6 and repaid maturing paper totalling 24.6 million dinars.
It sold three-year notes payable in equal annual tranches at a 7.1250 percent coupon rate for an amount of two million dinars and 7.3750 percent for nine million dinars.
The last time the treasury sold three-year notes was in December at an average 8.0437 percent coupon rate.
Banks bid for 61 million dinars of three-year notes at between 7.1250 and 7.5000 percent. (one $=1.09 dinar)
